name: Blender
tagline: Drive Blender from your Flowly agent — render, export, and run bpy scripts via chat.
description: Headless Blender automation. The agent can render `.blend` files, export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/USDZ/STL/PLY, inspect scenes, and execute arbitrary `bpy` scripts. Auto-detects GPU (Metal / OPTIX / CUDA / HIP / oneAPI), validates output, and ships render presets for fast preview vs production quality.
